what: On hover the text (or arrow) slides 100% up and out while the same text slides in from below (.4s relax). The arrow cell exits to the right and enters from the left — the direction is chosen per variant.

options.dir: Exit direction top · right · bottom · left, default top — can also be set per panel with data-dir

from.where: shared.js [data-hover-move] (header menu·button text top, arrow cell right, table-of-contents icon bottom)
